svg.title: Three ways to run IBM Maximo Application Suite
svg.desc: Three ways to run Maximo Application Suite: client-managed software on premises; client-managed software on a hyperscaler; or software as a service, including SaaS through AWS. IBM licenses the suite in AppPoints: each application and user type takes a set number.
